shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && ls && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; git ls-files

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "dialog|modal" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; cat tsconfig.json
sed -n 165,185p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Dialog Button; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
npm view @gravity-ui/components version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/
npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | grep -B3 '\^7.3' | grep version | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 dependencies --json | tail -15

npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json | python3 -c "
import json,sys
for e in json.load(sys.stdin): print(e['version'], e['peerDependencies'].get('@gravity-ui/uikit'))" | tail -8
npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 peerDependencies --json > /tmp/p.json; node -e "for (const e of require('/tmp/p.json')) console.log(e.version, e.peerDependencies['@gravity-ui/uikit'])" | tail -6
node -e "for (const e of require('/tmp/p.json')) console.log(e.version, JSON.stringify(e.peerDependencies||e))" | tail -6

npm install @gravity-ui/components@~4.23.1 2>&1 | tail -5; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build 2>/dev/null | head

rg -n -i -C3 "required setup|install|styles|css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -60; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog; ls $D; cat $D/ConfirmDialog.d.ts; ls $D/../; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json | grep -n '"version"\|uikit'
